name: @projexlight/sdk-pool-router
summary: Tenant-to-pool routing for ProjexCloud's pool-based horizontal scaling (no sharding). Resolves (tenant_id, kind) → pool_index for admin / app / evidence / etc. pools; supports pool lifecycle flips (active / degraded / drain) with Redis pub/sub so every gateway replica picks up status changes within a 5-min TTL. Owns pool_federation_manifest for P7 lakehouse federation + active-active replication profiles.

endpoints.description: Resolve (tenant_id, kind) → pool_index. Cached locally; invalidated by pool:status-flip pub/sub.
List all pools with current status, tenant_count, capacity utilization.
Fetch a single pool with its lifecycle history.
Flip pool status (active / degraded / drain). Broadcasts pool:status-flip on Redis.

events.name: pool.status.flipped.v1
events.description: Pool transitioned status. Carries old + new status + operator_id. Every gateway invalidates its route cache.

events.name: pool.tenant.assigned.v1
events.description: A (tenant, kind) pair was assigned to a pool. Consumed by sdk-tenant on provision.

events.name: pool.federation.manifest.updated.v1
events.description: P7: Pool federation manifest updated (Iceberg lakehouse routing). Consumed by lineage-projector + semantic-service.

events.name: active-active.drill.completed.v1
events.description: Failover drill finished; report attached for the operator console.

models.description: Pool definition with capacity targets, current status, DSN hint, replica topology.
The lookup table: (tenant_id, kind) → pool_index. Hot-cached in Redis; invalidated by pub/sub.
Full status-flip history per pool; powers the operator audit trail.
P7: which pools participate in cross-pool Iceberg lakehouse reads.
Per-tenant active-active config: sync vs async replication preference, RPO/RTO targets.
Per-(tenant, table-family) replication stream state + lag metrics.
Drill runs: scheduled_at, executed_at, lag_at_drill, write_routing_during_drill, report.

hooks.name: resolvePool
hooks.description: Synchronous resolve — checks in-memory cache → Redis → Postgres. Used in the gateway hot path.

hooks.name: setCache
hooks.description: Inject a custom RouteCache (defaults to InMemoryRouteCache; production swaps for RedisRouteCache).

hooks.name: installRedisUsageCounter
hooks.description: Wire the Redis-backed usage counter so soft-cap checks in the gateway stay O(1).

hooks.name: subscribeToFlips
hooks.description: Subscribe to Redis pool:status-flip channel; called automatically by RedisRouteCache.subscribeToFlips().

scenarios.title: Resolve the pool for an incoming request (gateway hot path)
scenarios.when_to_use: Every request the api-gateway accepts. The gateway looks up which DB pool to talk to before doing anything else.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Sub-ms when Redis cache hits. Falls back to Postgres on miss + populates the cache. Returns pool_index string used by db-runtime.

scenarios.title: Drain a pool to roll capacity without dropping connections
scenarios.when_to_use: Operator scaling down a pool. Flip to 'drain' so new traffic routes elsewhere; in-flight connections finish naturally.
scenarios.example_code:
await fetch(`${gw}/admin/pools/pool-42/status`, { method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify({ status: 'drain' }) });
// Wait for connection count to fall to 0 (typically <5 min), then decommission.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Emits pool.status.flipped.v1. Redis pool:status-flip broadcast invalidates every gateway replica's route cache within the TTL window (default 5 min). New traffic routes to peer pools; existing connections drain.

scenarios.title: Tenant provisioned → assign initial admin + app pools
scenarios.when_to_use: sdk-tenant provisions a new tenant; we need a pool to write its initial rows to.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Writes to routing.tenant_pool_map. Emits pool.tenant.assigned.v1. New tenant's requests now resolve cleanly through resolvePool().

scenarios.title: Run a multi-region active-active failover drill
scenarios.when_to_use: Monthly compliance drill for Tier-G+ tenants. Validates RPO/RTO targets are still met under simulated primary outage.
scenarios.expected_outcome: active_active.failover_drill row recorded with lag_at_drill_ms + write_routing_during_drill. Report visible in operator console. Yellow flag if any replica lag > 5 s; red flag if a replica refused writes.

scenarios.title: P7: register a cross-pool federation manifest for lakehouse reads
scenarios.when_to_use: Analytics queries (sdk-analytics + Iceberg) need to read across multiple per-tenant app pools without rehydrating data into one warehouse.
scenarios.expected_outcome: lineage-projector + semantic-service receive the manifest; their next read plans include the federation set. Read federation lakehouse satisfies G11 (PRD §3 P7).

compliance_posture.notes: Pool resolution NEVER crosses jurisdiction. A tenant in eu-west-1 routes only to pools tagged eu-west-1 — enforced at the assignTenant() layer + checked at every resolvePool() call. Active-active replication preference is per-tenant; opt-out forces single-region strict consistency.

pricing_skus.unit_description: per resolve call (rarely a hot SKU; cached aggressively)
per drill run (typically monthly per tenant)
